questions.stem: The system of binomial nomenclature was introduced by
questions.explanation: Linnaeus gave each organism a two part scientific name.

questions.stem: The basic unit of biological classification is
questions.explanation: Species is the lowest and basic taxonomic category.

questions.stem: The correct sequence of taxonomic categories in descending order is
questions.explanation: Hierarchy runs Kingdom, Division, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species.

questions.stem: A herbarium is a collection of
options: Dried, pressed and preserved plant specimens
questions.explanation: Herbarium sheets carry dried specimens with label data.

questions.stem: ICBN stands for
questions.explanation: It lays down the rules for naming plants.

questions.stem: Living plant collections maintained for reference and study are kept in a
questions.explanation: Botanical gardens maintain living plants with scientific labels.

questions.stem: The organelle known as the powerhouse of the cell is
questions.explanation: Mitochondria carry out aerobic respiration and produce ATP.

questions.stem: Cell theory was proposed by
questions.explanation: Schleiden studied plants and Schwann animals, jointly proposing the cell theory.

questions.stem: The ribosomes found in prokaryotic cells are of the type
questions.explanation: Prokaryotes have 70S ribosomes made of 50S and 30S subunits.

questions.stem: The plant cell wall is composed mainly of
questions.explanation: Cellulose microfibrils form the primary structural material of plant cell walls.

questions.stem: The site of photosynthesis in a plant cell is the
questions.explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll and carry out photosynthesis.

questions.stem: The main function of the Golgi apparatus is
questions.explanation: The Golgi complex modifies, packages and dispatches cell products.

questions.stem: The light reaction of photosynthesis takes place in the
questions.explanation: Photosystems are embedded in the thylakoid membranes.

questions.stem: The first stable product formed in C4 plants is
questions.explanation: C4 fixation produces the four carbon oxaloacetic acid first.

questions.stem: The Calvin cycle occurs in the
questions.explanation: Carbon fixation enzymes are dissolved in the stroma.

questions.stem: The primary acceptor of carbon dioxide in C3 plants is
questions.explanation: RuBisCO adds CO2 to ribulose 1,5 bisphosphate.

questions.stem: Oxygen released during photosynthesis comes from
questions.explanation: Photolysis of water in photosystem II releases oxygen.

questions.stem: Chlorophyll a shows maximum absorption in which regions of the spectrum?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll a absorbs strongly in the blue violet and red regions.

questions.stem: The double helix model of DNA was proposed by
questions.explanation: Watson and Crick proposed the model in 1953 using Franklin's X-ray data.

questions.stem: In a DNA molecule, adenine pairs with
questions.explanation: A pairs with T through two hydrogen bonds in DNA.

questions.stem: The enzyme that joins Okazaki fragments during replication is
questions.explanation: Ligase seals the nicks between adjacent fragments on the lagging strand.

questions.stem: The central dogma of molecular biology is
questions.explanation: Genetic information flows from DNA through RNA to protein.

questions.stem: Transcription in prokaryotes is carried out by
questions.explanation: A single RNA polymerase makes all classes of RNA in bacteria.

questions.stem: The number of nucleotides that make up one codon is
questions.explanation: The genetic code is a triplet code.
